Arabic: مرحبا بالعالم
Arabic with diacritics: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُم
Hebrew: שלום עולם
Hebrew with niqqud: שָׁלוֹם עוֹלָם
Mixed LTR/RTL: Hello مرحبا World עולם — bidi rendering test
RTL number: ٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩
Arabic-Indic: ۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹
We don't support full RTL rendering in MVP — these strings should not crash and should display in logical (memory) order.
